title: Role of artificial intelligence in revolutionizing drug discovery

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine, particularly through machine learning (ML), marked a significant progression in drug discovery.
